game.label: The folder with your three original Amiga disk images of It Came from the Desert (Disk 1, 2 and 3). Plain .adf files, whatever they are called. The add-on's three disks in the same folder are used too.

prepare.label: The game's files from your three disks

settings.label: Window
settings.help: Fullscreen fills your screen with the game's 4:3 picture. Windowed gives you a window you can resize and leave at the size you like.

settings.label: Music
settings.help: How loud the game's music is, from 0 (off) to 10.

settings.label: Sound effects
settings.help: How loud the game's sound effects and voices are, from 0 (off) to 10.

settings.label: Language
settings.help: The language of the game's own text. English is the original's; German is the translation that ships with it.

settings.label: Side curtains
settings.help: The port's own curtains in the bars beside the picture when the window is wider than the game's 4:3 screen. Off leaves those bars black.

actions.label: Saves
actions.help: The ten save slots and your settings.

actions.label: Run log
actions.help: The state of the last run that did not end by itself.

looks.reason: It Came from the Desert draws through Windows GDI, which ReShade cannot filter.
